verdict.rationale: Foreloop lets you create API keys under Settings → Connections → API keys and recommends one key per integration so each can be revoked on its own. Agents authenticate to the MCP endpoint with such a key, and the widget example uses a "write-only" key, which suggests some key scoping exists. However, nothing shows that agent keys can be restricted to particular permissions, projects or repositories. Missing for 10: documented scope/permission options for agent keys, per-project or per-repo restriction, expiry controls, independent corroboration.
